title: Ja'Lynn Polk, 2024 second-round pick, abruptly retires at 24 years old

sources.title: Ja'Lynn Polk, 2024 second-round pick, abruptly retires at 24 years old
sources.description: In a surprising decision, the 24-year-old Ja'Lynn Polk called it a career after just a few seasons in the NFL.
